skeleton.meaning: One head binding supplies rigid follow. Bone weights do not distinguish roots, lengths or free tips.

skinRelation.method: Exact AST reuse of existing Source.bind, all actual Body_SKIN and Face_SKIN triangles, no Y/nearest subset selection.
skinRelation.scope: Unsigned nearest distance only. This is not scalp annotation, attachment proof, signed penetration or continuous edge/triangle clearance.

tools.topology: scipy.sparse.csgraph.connected_components plus exact index edge multiplicity
